dsh-auto 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

posts.en:
dsh-auto is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-543fb6ff60c6cf30bdee.html
